assets.title: 牛肉好菜
assets.subtitle: 浓香或鲜嫩，挑个合口味
assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create one finished, full-bleed rectangular Chinese restaurant category banner, with accurate integrated Chinese typography, not a UI screenshot.
Fresh vivid green tabletop in the #2F7D32 family fills the whole scene, with restrained soft gouache brushwork, delicate paper texture and soft warm side light. Elegant premium hand-painted food editorial art, inviting and refined, not photorealistic, not dark, not cartoon icons. Tiny warm wood notes may appear at the outer bottom corners only. Milk-white ivory ceramic, vibrant greens and appetizing warm-gold food colors. A delicate simple pale-gold hairline border is inset from all edges, elegant and quiet, with no ornamental flourishes.
Layout is rigorously centered: exact title and subtitle are horizontally centered on the canvas and share the same vertical center line. Together the two text lines sit in the middle of the full banner. The CENTRAL 75 PERCENT of the width is clean gently textured medium-fresh green with strong contrast and no food, no steam, no props behind words. Food is integrated into the tabletop at the TWO FAR OUTER SIDES, never crossing behind the text. Do not use a left-aligned heading, do not reserve an empty side for later text, and do not place all the food on just one side.
Typography: large HEAVY BOLD Chinese display type, refined thick Songti / restaurant sign lettering, crisp legible strokes in bright warm ivory with restrained pale-gold detail, not thin calligraphy.
